translation: <ins>Shu Xue Wan (疏血丸)</ins> This medicine stops bleeding and opens the stomach. Plant soot (百草霜, three qian), good donkey-hide gelatin (好阿膠, stir-fried with clam shell into pearls), lotus node (藕節), biota leaf (側柏葉), cogongrass root (茅根), Chinese angelica (當歸, washed in wine, each one liang). Grind all together into a fine powder, refine honey into pills the size of wutong seeds, take five qian each time, sent down with old wine morning and evening. <ins>Wu Jia Pi Tang (五加皮湯)</ins> This decoction relaxes sinews and harmonizes blood, settles pain and disperses stasis.
